name: Jax
title: Grandmaster at Arms

Q.name: Leap Strike
Q.description: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing 65/105/145/185/225 + 1×bonus AD physical damage if it is an enemy.
Q.summary: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

W.name: Empower
W.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional 50/85/120/155/190 + 0.6×AP magic damage.
W.summary: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

E.name: Counter Strike
E.description: Jax enters a defensive stance for up to 2 seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking 25% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After 2 seconds or Recasting, Jax deals 40/70/100/130/160 + 0.7×bonus AP + 4% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for 1 second. The damage is increased by 20% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of (40/70/100/130/160 + 0.7×bonus AP) × 2 + (4) × 2% max Health.
E.summary: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

R.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.description: Passive: Every third Attack within 2.5 seconds deals an additional 75/130/185 + 0.6×AP magic damage. Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing 100/175/250 + 1×bonus AP magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains 45/60/75 + 0.4×bonus AD Armor and (45/60/75 + 0.4×bonus AD) × 0.6 Magic Resist plus 20/25/30 + 0.1×bonus AD Armor and (20/25/30 + 0.1×bonus AD) × 0.6 Magic Resist per additional champion hit for 8 seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.
R.summary: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

Passive.name: Relentless Assault
Passive.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.
Passive.summary: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Scaling melee duelist whose E dodges all basic attacks and then stuns. He leaps to any unit with Q and grows stronger with every item into a late-game side-lane threat.
strengths: E dodges all attacks and stuns nearby enemies
Q leaps to wards, minions or allies for engage and escape
Strong level 1 thanks to passive attack speed and E
W attack reset for quick trades
weaknesses: E answered by Fiora W, or outwaited by holding damage
Weak to magic damage/AoE before R
profile.curveNote: Reviewer: Jax's level 1 is typically strong (passive + E).

Q.notes: Leap to any unit or ward.

W.notes: Empowers next attack or Q; attack reset.

E.notes: Dodges attacks for 2 s, then stuns. Stop attacking.

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown: trade and walk away.
